name: labs/hgomersall__pyzaber
title: Zaber multiaxis linear slides (pyzaber)
intro: Zaber multiaxis linear slides (pyzaber), adapted from hgomersall/pyzaber. It reads `x_mm`, `y_mm` and `z_mm`; runs `home`, `move_to_position` and `stop_motion`. `home`: home all three axes with the native home command (command 1); the clone's example homes x, y and z in turn. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/hgomersall__pyzaber --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/hgomersall__pyzaber --backend fake --mcp
